subject.title: Sub-agent startup silence: no first-progress signal, aborted runs appear as hangs

question: Should OpenClaw add `first-progress` and typed `startup-failed` as core agent lifecycle semantics for subagent startup failures, or solve the silent-startup problem through existing terminal outcome and diagnostics paths only?
rationale: This is a real subagent workflow problem, but the proposed solution creates a new core lifecycle/API surface that crosses gateway, session, SDK, and subagent consumers.

options.title: Approve Fresh Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Ask for a current-main implementation of the two phases with compatibility tests and real startup-failure proof, and close or replace the stale open branch.

options.title: Use Existing Terminal Outcomes
options.body: Keep lifecycle phases as `start`/`end`/`error` and require a narrower fix that improves terminal outcome attribution and diagnostics without new event phases.

options.title: Defer Core API Change
options.body: Leave external watchdogs or diagnostics as the interim path until maintainers commit to a broader lifecycle API revision.

recommendation.title: Approve Fresh Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main implementation of the two phases with compatibility tests and real startup-failure proof, and close or replace the stale open branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and prior subagent lifecycle commits make steipete the strongest available owner for deciding the core lifecycle contract shape.
